_comment: Multi-language (TypeScript) benchmark — reviewer issue #3. A small cross-file
Express-style app with 8 planted vulnerabilities. Line numbers read from the
.ts files directly. Categories normalized by eval.py (SQLi/Auth Bypass/Weak
Honest note: Autopsy's dependency-graph extraction is Python-centric. Even
after fixing exported-function extraction, idiomatic TS (anonymous Express
route handlers) is not captured as graph nodes and cross-file CALL edges are
not built, so the graph-guided path is much weaker on TS than Python. The LLM
scan still sees raw TS source. See benchmark/js_demo/README.md.

vulnerabilities.description: runQuery: raw SQL string passed to conn.query with no binding (sink, line 8).
hashPassword: MD5 used for password hashing (line 10).
/users/search: req.query.q concatenated into SQL forwarded to runQuery (line 11).
/users/:id: isAuthorized() return value ignored, so the check is a no-op (line 18).
/users/:id: req.body.name and id concatenated into UPDATE SQL forwarded to runQuery (line 20).
/fetch: fetch() on a user-controlled URL with no allowlist (line 33).
